metcon.name: Well, that escalated Chiefly
metcon.description:
Partner Workout
Teams of two IGYG each round
5 x 4min AMRAP, 1min rest between
1 round IGYG
3 Cleans
6 Push ups
9 Air Squats
Then tag in your partner
MIN 0-4:: RX 40/30, RX+ 60/40  then 4:00-5:00rest
Min 5-9:  RX 50/35, RX+ 70/45 then  9:00-10:00rest
MIN 10-14: RX 60/40, RX+ 80/50 then 14:00-15:00rest
MIN 15-19: RX 70/45, RX+ 90/55 then 19:00-20:00rest)
MIN 20-24: RX 80/50, RX+ 100/60 then rest
score total reps
scale last weight to be max 80% of 1RM and work backward

hypertrophy.reasoning: Cleans and push-ups tax anterior chain; accessory work targets posterior chain and arm musculature for balance.
suggested_exercises: Pendlay rows or seal rows: 3 x 8–10
